summary: Bind maintenance reconciliation inputs to the verified published 4.2.0 packages.
details: The optional nine-target maintenance reconciliation lane authenticates the preserved 4.2.0 release inventory and binds each actual predecessor archive to its target, path, version, raw hash, size and content inventory.

Candidate, upgrade-receipt, exact-engine, continuity-assertion and hashed-log checks remain mandatory. Historical terminal records retain baseline provenance separately from the executed published CCC00 predecessor.

The maintenance reconciliation record remains private and unqualified. Source controls and local published-package binding checks create no native upgrade proof. Independent rehash, real-engine evidence consumption and complete 4.2.1 acceptance remain pending.
